_comment: Batch 006 -- the portal's two states and the standard door.
The portal shots load the APPROVED frame (batch002/portal_b2_wound)
with each core in it, because a core photographed alone is a picture
of a membrane and the question is what the portal reads as.
Both state shots share one orbit, for the reason the Check's did: a
comparison taken from two distances compares the distances.

shots.name: P_portal_states
shots.caption: THE PORTAL - SEALED, THEN OPEN. SAME WOUND, TORN
shots.note: SOLID AGAINST HOLED READS AT ANY DISTANCE AND IN ANY TINT

shots.name: P_portal_locked
shots.caption: SEALED - THE WOUND HAS GROWN OVER THE APERTURE
shots.note: IDENTITY GREEN AT ITS DARKEST STEP. NOT A NEW FAMILY

shots.name: P_portal_unlocked
shots.caption: OPEN - THE SAME GROWTH RETRACTED TO THE EDGES
shots.note: EXIT_PORTAL.GD RUNS THIS AT 2.0 EMISSION ENERGY, SEALED AT 0.5

shots.name: P_portal_walkup
shots.caption: WALK-UP AT THE ENGINE'S OWN LENS - IS THERE A WAY THROUGH?

shots.name: P_portal_cores
shots.caption: THE TWO CORES ALONE - 108 TRIS EACH, ONE MATERIAL EACH
shots.note: ONE MATERIAL SO A MESH SWAP AND A MATERIAL_OVERRIDE BOTH WORK

shots.name: P_door_standard
shots.caption: DOOR LINING - 2.4 X 3.2 M, THE GAP CHAMBER_BUILDERS CUTS
shots.note: THEME TRIM, NOT A UNIVERSAL FAMILY. A LINING IS NOT AN INTERACTABLE

shots.name: P_door_through
shots.caption: WALKING AT IT - THE REVEAL IS THE SURFACE YOU LOOK STRAIGHT AT
shots.note: 0.4 M OF WALL THICKNESS, LINED, INSTEAD OF A CUT EDGE
